2026-07-22 — wiki/ cleanup done

Cleared wiki/ from the checkout. These were cached mirrors pulled from wiki.spindle.dev that duplicated what's already in docs/ — the content drifts since the wiki is community-edited, so we don't keep the local copies. Standard practice: delete wiki/ at session start, then proceed with whatever's queued.

Branch work/ingest-backoff is ready for the Thursday cut. Backoff improvements look solid in staging.
